criteria.criterion: One new growth_get_monthly_summary tool is exposed through the existing OpenSEO MCP server only.
criteria.note: The real in-process server advertises the tool through tools/list; no second server or transport was added.

criteria.criterion: The only semantic input is projectId and canonical project authorization completes before the Growth read.
criteria.note: Unauthorized projects fail before the monthly service or any report mutation spy is called.

criteria.criterion: Authorized execution delegates only to getGrowthMonthlyReport(projectId) and performs no build, publication, provider, scheduling or credit work.
criteria.note: The handler has one Growth service call, and focused tests assert exact one-read/no-write behavior.

criteria.criterion: Tool annotations and description truthfully declare read-only, closed-world, non-destructive, zero-credit behavior that never builds or publishes.
criteria.note: Both definition-level and advertised protocol annotations are exercised.

criteria.criterion: Structured output wraps only the existing strict monthly DTO plus optional standard metadata.
criteria.note: Actual output validates, and an injected internal actor field is rejected; IDs, sources, evidence, actors and hashes are not introduced.

criteria.criterion: Ready, no-activity, Draft and Published text remains truthful and includes the bounded stored report content in order.
criteria.note: Tests cover lifecycle-specific wording, publication timestamp behavior and every one of the eight ordered sections, items and scalar facts.

criteria.criterion: Project metadata contains the authorized project ID and canonical Growth monthly-summary deep link.
criteria.note: The link retains the monthly-summary fragment through the standard URL/meta helpers.

criteria.criterion: Existing MCP registration retains output validation and instrumentation and is discoverable/callable through the real protocol boundary.
criteria.note: An MCP Client uses linked InMemoryTransport to list and call the real createOpenSeoMcpServer without network access.

criteria.criterion: SAM mirrors the exact definition, removes projectId from model input and injects the session-bound project before authorization.
criteria.note: The SAM test proves the empty model-facing schema and bound-project authorization/read calls.

criteria.criterion: The slice remains a current previous-complete-month read and adds no arbitrary history or write/share surface.
criteria.note: No period, mutation or share input exists; deferred boundaries are explicit in ADR-036.

criteria.criterion: No dependency, schema, migration, repository, provider, billing, auth, scope, transport, public route, UI or print change was added.
criteria.note: Changes are limited to the shared tool, two registration points, tests, ADR and run evidence.

criteria.criterion: Required focused tests, full suite, repository CI, production build, diff check and independent review pass.
criteria.note: 35 focused and 1,975 full-suite tests passed; ci:check, build and diff-check passed; the fresh review has no outstanding findings.

limitations: Raw HTTP transport and an external headless MCP consumer probe were not run because the user's standing constraint prohibits HTTP and headless/browser activity. Those layers are not claimed as passed; a real no-network MCP client/server protocol exercise is included instead.
do_not_change: Keep the handler limited to canonical project authorization followed by one getGrowthMonthlyReport(projectId) call.
Keep the existing strict monthly DTO as the structured summary boundary.
Keep the exact shared definition registered through the existing MCP helper and SAM's server-bound project adapter.
Keep build, publication, history and sharing out of this read tool.
